author: WarMahdi Studio
description: |cffffd700★ (8) Crown of WarMahdi v7 ★|r — 8-Empire Sunken-Astral Altered Melee (4v4 / 2v2 / FFA). 4 Classic Races + 4 Custom Empires: |cff22d3eeAbyssal Tideborn (with Illidan)|r, |cfffbbf24Sunfury Imperium|r, |cfff97316Voidborn Legion|r & |cff38bdf8Runeforged Bastion|r! Features 16 heroes and 64 native-art skills; core ranks unlock at levels 1/3/5 and ultimates at level 6. Restored signature Mana Burn, Phoenix and Resurrection skills, race-matched role-distinct buildings (including three unique Naga shop/forge/pool models), and distinct custom-race AI openings. Includes 64 skill-specific, geometrically varied spell MDX effects plus six faction sigils, custom cursor/RPG UI, and the preserved Sunken-Astral terrain.
compatibility: Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne 1.26a / 1.27b (Atinad, GameRanger, LAN)
